attempted_claim: Let M be a closed, smooth, oriented, 2-connected 7-manifold whose integral cohomology ring is isomorphic to that of an S^3-bundle over S^4 (so H^4(M;Z) is Z_{|n|} for some n, with Z_0 := Z). Does M admit a Riemannian metric with nonnegative sectional curvature? Equivalently, is every Crowley diffeomorphism type — linking form, quadratic refinement, spin class and generalised Eells-Kuiper invariant — occurring for this cohomology ring realised by a closed simply connected 7-manifold admitting sec >= 0, in particular by one admitting a codimension-one singular Riemannian foliation with codimension-two singular leaves / Seifert fibration over the orbifold S^4 with generic fibre S^3?
decisive_failure: The investigation was blocked by the unavailability of the full Goette adiabatic-limit/Dedekind-sum Eells-Kuiper formulae and the Goette-Kerin-Shankar construction-to-Crowley-invariant image map, which cannot be reconstructed from search snippets or first principles within a one-hour session; classical curvature obstructions all vanish on this highly connected class, so neither constructive realisation nor rigorous disproof of the complete target was reachable, and the assessed adjacent alternatives failed full Audit on originality and independent value.
